title: Societies compared: verified targets for the money (gptoss-shared-1)

design.question: For the same agents, checker and money, does OSO reach the same verified targets for less than other ways of organizing the agents?
design.fixed: the same 4 agents (the single agent: the first, with all the money), $0.60 in all, Lean checks every proof
design.measure: money spent to verify 2 of the counted targets (C3, A3, C4, X1, B3, B5, X2, A5); a run that never does counts as its whole budget

caveats: Labs could stop early by passing, so setups are compared at the same money offered; money spent is shown beside each.

Rewards differ from the current simulation model: the knowledge reward is off (the simulation pays 1 per new bit since v5): Lean has no agreed measure of a result's new knowledge yet, see docs/design.md; value flowing back is still split by the money spent proving each parent, not by the work a parent saves (1/p) as in the simulation.
Values are mean ± standard deviation over runs; the verdict compares runs in pairs (run k of each society), with ± two standard errors of the difference.
